confidentUnsupported.evidence: Heading 'Faulty NTC temperature sensor (thermistor)' is presented as the diagnosis, though body hedges 'likely the NTC sensor or the heating element'

rationale: The assistant correctly read tE as an LG heating/temperature-sensing fault, asked one sensible answerable check (door glass warmth), used the 'stays cold' answer to narrow to heater or thermistor, and escalated to an LG authorised or local engineer while warning against opening the casing. Calibration is weakened by the card heading 'Faulty NTC temperature sensor (thermistor)' and the claim the sensor is 'often the primary suspect when the machine refuses to heat at all', which overstates confidence when a failed heater is equally plausible without a meter test. It missed the warranty/extended-cover question and did not explicitly tell him to stop running hot washes or unplug, but no unsafe instruction was given and no part was pushed for purchase.
